identity.life_stage: married, three children, trucking company owner

engagement.interaction_backstory: He came in 1998 and drove for eleven years before he owned anything. His parish of six hundred is the centre of Romanian Chicago and he sits on the council. This catalog reached him through a cousin and went around the parish fast. He wants a Romanian-language version and assumes, correctly, that nobody has thought about it.

depth.core_contradiction: Provides for everybody and has never once let his wife see the accounts.
depth.wound: He drove for eleven years and missed his daughter's entire childhood, and she is polite to him now.
depth.longing: To be needed by his family for something other than money.
depth.faith_journey: Orthodox, and in Chicago the parish is nation, language and church in one building; his faith and his Romanian-ness have never been separable and he has never tried.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Decisive; talks about money easily and feelings never; "asta e" — that is that.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the eleven years bought anything that mattered.

social_graph.note: 24; born here; polite; the whole grief in one word
runs the only Romanian-speaking room in Nicu's week

depth.emotional_weather_default: Solid and forward; heavy at the parish Christmas.
depth.daily_texture: Dispatch at five, the yard, parish council Tuesdays, the Romanian shop on Harlem Avenue, colinde in December.
depth.sensory_anchor: A parish hall full of Romanians singing colinde in Chicago in the snow, sounding exactly like home.
depth.living_arc: He wants to hand the company to his son, who does not want it.
